text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... *sigh*. Alright, I don't feel dizzy 
standing up anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Good grief. Stumbling out of nowhere 
like that... Be careful the next time you 
stand up from your wheelchair, alright?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Doctor, are you eating three proper meals 
a day? Ensuring you get all the necessary 
nutrients should help prevent things like 
anemia.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. For meals... I do try to keep 
them as balanced as—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...When I went to the Doctor's lab before, 
it was completely full of cup noodles, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... B-But listen to me! I do take 
supplements! Lots of them! I especially 
buy zinc and vitamins by the box—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Doctor, supplements are 'dietary 
supplements.' If you make them your main 
meals, you risk dangers like nutrient 
overdose.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Why don't you just cook for yourself? 
That'd at least fix your unbalanced diet.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...Cooking, not really. I have almost... 
zero experience...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll teach you next time. When are you 
free? This is a great opportunity. Let's 
solve your dietary issues, Doctor!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I wonder? Is my schedule... open? 
I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Just give it up. ...I'm keeping that day 
open too, after all.
